description: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike, backed entirely by remote sources through Gelato. No local media is assumed. Own auth/session runtime and directly rendered screens, not a reskin of native jellyfin-web components.
name: Jellio
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike.

## [1.87.10] - 2026-10-20

### Bug Fixes

- *(search)* Resolve error toast when opening search results by handling unimported remote titles via on-demand metadata fallback
- *(detail)* Harden detail view against non-array genres, null item payloads, and missing metadata fields
- *(carousel)* Ensure hero carousel candidates require valid backdrop images and complete metadata, add art preloading, and synchronize slide state transitions
- *(i18n)* Add missing home_action_details and core interface translation keys across all supported display languages

## [1.87.9] - 2026-10-20

### Features

- *(subtitles)* Add explicit "Off (no subtitles by default)" option to the onboarding setup wizard and playback settings
- *(playback)* Default subtitle selection in the onboarding setup wizard to Off to prevent forced auto-selection
- *(sync)* Save SubtitleMode to None and synchronize default subtitles to server profile preferences across sessions and devices
- *(player)* Ensure player auto-select respects SubtitleMode None and preferredLanguage off without attaching subtitle tracks

## [1.87.8] - 2026-10-20

### Features

- *(achievements)* Complete translation coverage across all 46 achievement badges (names, descriptions, and unlock toasts) in all 7 supported display languages
- *(settings)* Netflix-style server preferences sync: seamlessly sync user playback, display, and recommendation settings to server profile across devices
- *(genres)* Dynamic catalog genre translations across Home screen rows, Settings genre selectors, and Detail view tags
- *(profile)* Fully localize lifetime and monthly statistics, category labels, overview tabs, and filter chips
- *(feed)* Refactor activity feed watch descriptions to prevent double prepositions ("von of"), translate season headers, and localize relative timestamps
- *(i18n)* Unified informal German phrasing ("Du / dein / dir / dich") and consistent informal tone across all languages
- *(settings)* Replace unstyled onboarding wizard button with native action card row
- *(cache)* Ensure complete cache purge and reload on display language change so metadata refreshes immediately in the target language

## [1.87.7] - 2026-10-20

### 🚀 Features

- *(i18n)* Complete 100% deep-dive UI localization across all remaining screens, components, dialogs, toasts, and controls
- *(i18n)* Exact dictionary parity across all 7 supported display languages (en, de, es, pl, fr, it, pt) with 795 keys each
- *(vocab)* Full localization for vocabulary deck management, SRS review sessions, flashcard intervals, and dictionary lookup states
- *(manga)* Localize chapter search filters, source checking statuses, Suwayomi CBZ format warnings, and shelf category assignment
- *(player)* Translate dialogue boost and night mode status toggles, cast device section, wireless streaming, and failover notifications
- *(settings)* Localize native application update descriptions and status indicators for macOS

## [1.87.5] - 2026-10-20

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- *(settings)* Translate all remaining Settings cards, form fields, action buttons, status messages, recommendation controls, and category headers across all supported languages
- *(onboarding)* Persist onboarding completion status to server display preferences so accounts that already configured settings or finished onboarding never see the setup wizard repeatedly on other devices
- *(home)* Localize home greetings (Good morning, Still up?) and dynamic recommendation headers (Top Picks for You, Because you watched)
- *(switcher)* Localize account switcher actions and profile titles
